name: Archidona (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and white, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Archidona (a castle on red and a sun and figure on blue).
history: The official symbols of Archidona are its flag and its arms; the flag was approved on 30 November 2004 and the arms by the Junta de Andalucía on 14 January 2005. The flag is described as rectangular like the traditional ones, of proportions 3:2, parted vertically green, the vexillological colour corresponding to heraldic sinople, and white, charged with the local arms.

features.role: Archidona arms — castle on red, sun and figure on blue
